acceptanceCriteria: NOTIFICATIONS declares three explicit fields and update-notifications requires exactly dailySummaryEnabled, summaryTime and soakRemindersEnabled; no legacy enabled argument remains on this screen.
Production snapshots render independent persisted values with default 09:00 and execute one validated command that updates all three preferences.
EN/RU production resources label all three controls and remain key-parity complete.
Component and real settings integration tests prove command preparation, persistence, restart, independence and legacy safe defaults. Specialist does not run Gradle.
goal: Replace the legacy Notifications enabled form with independent dailySummaryEnabled, summaryTime and soakRemindersEnabled fields/command arguments, render the real persisted values, and prove command persistence/restart through component and settings integration tests.
